No depreciation, fixed asset purchases, loans, or other balance sheet items were present in the QuickBooks data beyond the single Checking account.

scheduleO.narrative: The Kansas City Woodworkers Guild Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization incorporated in Missouri in 1992. Its mission is to promote the art and craft of woodworking through education, community engagement, and shared access to tools and facilities. The Guild provides members with instruction, workshops, monthly meetings, special interest groups (including CNC, Hand Tool, Finishing, Carving, and Laser Engraver SIGs), Rough to Ready skill-building workshops, and a collaborative environment to develop woodworking skills at all levels.

The organization does not currently have a formal documented process for governing body review of the Form 990 prior to filing. The Treasurer reviews the return and presents it to officers. The organization intends to implement a formal review process in future years.

The organization makes its governing documents and financial statements available to the public upon written request directed to the Treasurer at 1717 Washington St, Kansas City, MO 64108-1121. The organization does not currently post these documents on its website (www.kcwg.org).
